board.figure.gained: Help bubble of a leaderboard column. "Tiles" is the name of another column: use the same word as board.headTiles.
board.figure.today: Help bubble of a leaderboard column. "Tiles" and "Gained" are the names of other columns: use the same words as board.headTiles and board.headGained.
board.headRank: Head of the leaderboard's rank column, a symbol for "number".
board.headGained: Head of a leaderboard column: tiles taken today minus tiles lost.
board.headToday: Head of a leaderboard column: the points the country scores if the day ends now.
board.headBattle: Head of a leaderboard column during a battle. {icon} is a swords picture; the word in <hidden> is read by screen readers only; ×{times} multiplies the points.
board.first: Screen-reader name of the box of the country in first place.
board.ranksSum: {tilesRank} and {gainRank} are ordinals (1st, 2nd). "tiles" and "gained" are the leaderboard's columns.
board.leaderPoints: The leader's points: the big number in <amount>, the word under it in <unit>.
board.leaderShare: The leader's share of the map: the big number on top, the words in <unit> under it.
board.todayPoints: Points the country scores if the day ends now. The words in <hidden> are read by screen readers only.
board.battlePoints: Points the country scores if the battle ends now. The words in <hidden> are read by screen readers only.
board.rankOnTiles: Small rank under a number in the leaderboard; {rank} is an ordinal (1st). The words in <hidden> are read by screen readers only.
board.rankOnGained: Small rank under a number in the leaderboard; {rank} is an ordinal (1st). The words in <hidden> are read by screen readers only.
board.mapShare: A whole percent of the map or of a territory. {share} can be "<1".
board.admin: Name of a crown shown beside a game admin's name.
menu.share: Tab name, short: the place to share the game.
menu.invite: Tab name, short: the place to invite friends.
menu.you: Tab name, short: the player's own profile.
menu.missionsNews: Screen-reader name of the Missions tab with new missions.
menu.chatNews: Screen-reader name of the Chat tab with unread messages.
menu.places: Screen-reader name of the side bar of tabs.
menu.menu: Screen-reader name of the list of tabs.
menu.playingFor: Short label above the flag the player plays for.
menu.youArePlayingFor: Label above the flag the player plays for.
menu.change: Button: change the country the player plays for.
menu.locked: On the button to change country, while no change is allowed.
menu.minutesLeft: On the button to change country: the minutes until the next change.
menu.choice: Screen-reader name of a drop-down: its label, then the choice it shows.
menu.foldSummary: Screen-reader name of a section that folds: its title, then a short summary.
menu.buyMeACoffee: Button to the creator's page on Buy Me a Coffee, a site for tips.
hud.game: Screen-reader name of the bar of tabs at the bottom of a phone screen.
hud.overCap: Badge for more unread messages than {count}, as in 99+.
picker.country: Screen-reader name of the list of countries.
about.subtitle: Pixel Wars is the name of another game.
anthem.byNavyBand: Under the anthem's title: the country, and the band that recorded it (a name).
territory.sizeFree: The size of a territory, and how many of its tiles no flag holds.
territory.fortifiedBy: {flag} is the flag's picture, just before the country's name.
territory.toFortify: {flag} is a flag's picture: that flag needs this many more tiles to fortify the territory.
play.invite: Button and panel title: invite friends to play for your flag.
clicks.left: Beside the big number of clicks the player has left, in the click meter. {count} is that number; keep the words around it inside <unit>…</unit>. The number changes without the line being read again, so the words must fit every count.
clicks.factor: On a small chip: how many times slower the clicks refill, e.g. "2×".
clicks.nextIn: In the click meter: one more click comes in {time}, e.g. "+1 in 4s".
clicks.countOfCapacity: The clicks the player has, out of the most the bank holds, e.g. "12 of 30". {count} is shown big; keep the rest inside <of>…</of>.
clicks.refill: Column heading: how fast the clicks refill at each share of the map.
clicks.plainRate: In the refill column: no slowdown at this share of the map.
clicks.under: In the share column: a share of the map below this percent.
player.report: Button on a player's card: report this player to the moderators.
player.streak: Days in a row the player played.
player.foughtFor: Heading over the flags this player took tiles for.
player.foughtAgainst: Heading over the flags this player took tiles from.
player.deletedName: Shown in place of the name of an account that was deleted. Keep the brackets.
holder.youTookIt: On the card of a tile: {ago} is a relative time such as "3 hr. ago".
holder.tookIt: On the card of a tile, about another player: {ago} is a relative time such as "3 hr. ago".
title.wear: Button: show this title beside your name.
title.rank: {track} is the name of a series of titles, e.g. "Rank 2 of 5 · Conquest".
title.seasonLetter: One letter for "season", drawn on a medal's ribbon before the season's number ("S0"). One or two letters at most.
title.dayMoreTo: {day} is how many days in a row the player has played; {next} is the name of the next title.
title.countTo: {next} is the name of the next title.
connection.lost: A bar at the top of the screen; the words in <strong> are bold.
title.tilesTo: {next} is the name of the next title, e.g. "40 tiles to Raider".
title.messagesTo: {next} is the name of the next title, e.g. "40 tiles to Raider".
title.fortifiedTilesTo: {next} is the name of the next title, e.g. "40 tiles to Raider".
title.bombsTo: {next} is the name of the next title, e.g. "40 tiles to Raider".
title.boxesTo: {next} is the name of the next title, e.g. "40 tiles to Raider".
title.rightAnswersTo: {next} is the name of the next title, e.g. "40 tiles to Raider".
title.missionsTo: {next} is the name of the next title, e.g. "40 tiles to Raider".
settings.countryFlags: Settings: the label of three options that set how the country flags are drawn on the map when it is zoomed out.
settings.mapViewBig: An option of "Country flags": zoomed out, one big flag of the leading country covers each whole landmass.
settings.mapViewSplit: An option of "Country flags": zoomed out, each tile shows the small flag of the country that holds it.
settings.mapViewOff: An option of "Country flags": zoomed out, no flags, only the colored tiles.
settings.feedback: A button in the settings that opens a form to send a message to the game's maker.
settings.about: A button in the settings that opens a page about the game.
sound.sound: The main switch of the sound settings: turns every sound of the game on or off.
sound.anthem: A switch: plays the national anthem of the country that leads the board.
account.title: The heading and the tab of the player's account settings (username, sign-in, sign-out).
account.progressTab: A tab beside "Account": the player's titles and stats.
account.email: Sign-in by email, as the name of a service inside a sentence, like Google or Discord: "Signed in with Google and email", "Link email".
account.emailChip: Sign-in by email, as a short chip in a row of sign-in services: "Google", "Discord", "Email".
account.signedInWithLabel: A label above the chips of the sign-in services (Google, Discord, email) the player uses.
account.deleteConfirm: The button that confirms the deletion of the player's account.
account.welcomeBackPlay: A button (a verb) that closes the message and goes back to the game.
username.noneYet: Shown beside the label "Username" when the player has no username yet.
signIn.code: The label of the field where the player types the code that came by email.
signIn.link: A button (a verb): links this email address to the player's account.
signIn.emailPlaceholder: An example address in the empty email field. Use a made-up address that looks natural in the language.
signIn.fullBank: The bank holds the clicks a player can spend. Signing in fills it at once.
signIn.pitchName: {guest} is the start of the guests' names as the game writes them (guest_).
profile.streak: A noun: the number of days in a row the player has played.
profile.playingSince: A label before the date the player's account was made.
profile.worn: A small tag on the medal of the title the player wears now.
profile.titles: A heading: the titles (ranks such as "Raider") the player has earned.
season.todayEndsIn: Label over a countdown ("12h 05m 00s") to the end of today's scoring day.
season.endsIn: Label over a countdown to the end of the season.
season.tag: One word over a countdown on the phone's small chip: the countdown to the season's end.
season.todayTag: One word over a countdown on the phone's small chip: the countdown to the end of today.
season.win: Heading of a rule (a verb): how a country wins the season.
season.titles: Heading of a rule: the player titles (ranks) a season gives.
battle.tag: One word over a countdown on the phone's small chip: the countdown to the next battle, or to the end of the one that plays.
battle.nextIn: Label over a countdown to the next battle's start.
battle.endsIn: Label over a countdown to the end of the battle that plays.
battle.whenWorth: {when} is a day and hours; the battle scores {times} times a day's points.
battle.pointsTimes: The battle scores {times} times a day's points.
battle.wonTimes: The points a country won, then how many times they count ("25 ×3").
battle.cardPosition: Screen reader name of a card in a carousel ("1 of 3").
finale.tag: One word over a countdown on the phone's small chip: the Final Battle (the season's last battle).
finale.in: Label over a countdown to the Final Battle's start.
finale.endsIn: Label over a countdown to the end of the Final Battle.
finale.lengthOfWar: {length} is a length of time ("2 hours").
finale.lastWord: Heading: the Final Battle is the last thing that scores in a season.
round.newInTable: Mark beside a country new in the table, in place of a move up or down.
round.movedUp: Screen reader name of a move up the table by {places} places.
round.movedDown: Screen reader name of a move down the table by {places} places.
hallOfFame.view: Button: opens a past season's numbers.
hallOfFame.map: Link: opens the replay of a past season's map.
hallOfFame.kickerSeason: Small line over a slide's heading: the slide is about the whole season.
hallOfFame.slidePosition: Screen reader name of a slide in a carousel ("1 of 6").
hallOfFame.number.clicks: Heading over the number of clicks in a season.
hallOfFame.number.players: Heading over the number of players in a season.
hallOfFame.number.days: Heading over the number of days a season lasted.
race.measure: Screen reader name of a switch between two measures of a chart: points or map share.
race.points: Choice of a chart's measure: the points in the season's table.
race.mapShare: Choice of a chart's measure: the share of the map a country holds.
race.pointAtPoints: {when} is a day and time ("Sat 31 Oct, 21:00").
standings.rankColumn: Heading of the rank column of a table.
knockout.isOut: The country's capital was taken: it is out of the knock-out.
knockout.pickStillIn: A flag still in the knock-out (it still has a capital).
archive.seasonPicker: Screen reader name of the switch that picks a past season.
archive.window: Screen reader name of the switch between the whole season and its Final Battle.
archive.wholeSeason: Choice: the whole season, against its Final Battle alone.
archive.view: Screen reader name of the switch between the replay and the heatmap.
archive.time: Screen reader name of the time slider of a replay.
chat.world: The name of the chat room every player shares, on its tab beside the flag's own room.
chat.online: A tab of the chat: how many players are online now.
chat.roomUnread: Read by screen readers on a chat room's tab: the room's name, then what it has not read yet.
chat.openWith: Read by screen readers on the newest message shown over the folded chat: its author and its words.
chat.unread: A divider in the chat above the first message not read yet.
chat.seeNewMessages: A button over the chat: it scrolls down to the messages that came in.
chat.reply: A verb: the tooltip of the button that replies to a message.
chat.report: A verb: the tooltip of the button that reports a message to the moderators.
chat.reported: The mark on a message this player has reported already.
chat.quote.inReplyTo: Above a reply: the message it answers. {author} is a player's name, {text} the words of that message. The words in <hidden> are read by screen readers only.
chat.quote.replyingTo: Over the message box while the player writes a reply: the message it answers. {author} is a player's name, {text} the words of that message. The words in <hidden> are read by screen readers only.
chat.gif: What a chat line says in place of a GIF picture, and the label of the button that opens the GIFs.
chat.gifs: Read by screen readers: the button that opens the GIF search, and the search itself.
chat.composer.message: A noun: the name of the box where the player types a chat message.
chat.composer.as: Under the message box: the name the message goes out under.
chat.composer.asGuest: Under the message box: the message goes out under a guest's name.
chat.lockedRoom.title: {country} is the flag and the country's name: the chat of the players of that country.
gif.search: KLIPY is the name of the GIF service; keep it as it is.
reaction.count: Read by screen readers on a reaction: its name, then how many players gave it.
reaction.andMore: At the end of the list of the players who gave a reaction: how many more are not named.
reaction.laugh: The name of a reaction: a laughing face.
reaction.clown: The name of a reaction: a clown face.
reaction.skull: The name of a reaction: a skull.
reaction.fire: The name of a reaction: a flame.
reaction.cry: The name of a reaction: a crying face.
reaction.scream: The name of a reaction: a screaming face.
reaction.cool: The name of a reaction: a face with sunglasses.
reaction.think: The name of a reaction: a thinking face.
reaction.party: The name of a reaction: a party popper.
reaction.nerd: The name of a reaction: a nerd face with glasses.
reaction.earth: The name of a reaction: the globe.
announcement.fortified: {landmass} is an island or a country's land: its flag shielded every tile it holds there.
announcement.champion: {countries} is one country or a list of them, which won the season together.
announcement.bombedEmptyLand: The bomb fell on land where no flag held a tile.
bonus.refill: The name of a bonus, on its slot in the inventory and on the card that gives it: it fills the player's clicks.
bonus.bomb: The name of a bonus, on its slot in the inventory and on the card that gives it.
bonus.spread: The name of a bonus, on its slot in the inventory: while on, each click also takes the tiles around it.
bonus.enclose: The name of a bonus, on its slot in the inventory: while on, a closed ring of the player's tiles takes the tiles inside.
bonus.shield: The name of a bonus, on its slot in the inventory: a shield on a tile stops one enemy click.
inventory.empty: The "?" box is a bonus box that floats over the map; "one" is a bonus.
inventory.slot.count: What a screen reader says for a slot of the inventory: the bonus's name, then how many are held ("5/8").
inventory.slot.state: What a screen reader says for a slot of the inventory: the bonus's name, then its state (On, Aim, Full, New).
inventory.slot.countAndState: What a screen reader says for a slot of the inventory: the bonus's name, how many are held ("5/8"), its state (On, Aim, Full, New).
inventory.heldOfMost: How many of a bonus the player holds, over the most they can hold, on an inventory slot.
inventory.state.on: A small chip on an inventory slot: the bonus is switched on.
inventory.state.aim: A small chip on the bomb's slot: the bomb is being aimed (an imperative is fine).
inventory.state.full: A small chip on an inventory slot: the clicks or the tile are full already.
inventory.state.new: A small chip on an inventory slot: a bonus the player has never used.
mission.order.takeFor: {flag} is the player's flag: its picture and its country's name.
mission.order.takeFrom: {flag} is a rival flag: its picture and its country's name.
mission.order.takeIn: {place} is a country's land on the map: its flag's picture and its name.
mission.order.takeFromIn: {flag} is a rival flag, {place} a country's land on the map: each a flag's picture and a name.
mission.order.bombIn: {place} is a country's land on the map: its flag's picture and its name.
mission.order.breakShields: {flag} is a rival flag: its picture and its country's name. Break the shields on its tiles.
mission.progress.takeFrom: A short line under the globe while a mission moves on. {flag} is a rival flag's picture and name.
mission.progress.takeIn: A short line under the globe while a mission moves on. {place} is a country's flag picture and name.
mission.progress.takeFromIn: A short line under the globe while a mission moves on: {flag} is a rival flag's picture alone, {place} a country's flag picture and name.
mission.reachedOfGoal: How far a mission went over its goal, beside its progress bar: "37/60".
mission.done: A chip on a mission the player has finished.
mission.go: A button on a mission: the camera flies to where the mission is played.
mission.endsIn: {time} is the time left in the day, as "9h 00m".
mission.here.mission: {order} is a mission's order, as "Take 40 tiles from (flag) Algeria".
mission.here.flagMission: A mission the whole flag plays for season points. {order} is its order, as "Break 300 shields of (flag) Algeria".
mission.flagMission: A mission the whole flag plays for season points, not a bonus.
mission.flagDone.order: {order} is the mission's order, as "Break 300 shields of (flag) Algeria".
quiz.banner.title: The title of the banner that offers a quiz.
quiz.theAnswer: A screen reader reads it on the right choice of a quiz. {choice} is the choice as shown; the words in <hidden> are not shown, only read.
quiz.yourPick: A screen reader reads it on the wrong choice the player picked. {choice} is the choice as shown; the words in <hidden> are not shown, only read.
share.working: On a share button while the picture, video or link is being prepared
share.download: Button: saves the picture or the video to the device
share.downloaded: Button, after the picture or the video was saved to the device
share.card.standing: Drawn in capitals on the shared picture, under the flag's name
share.card.noTilesYet: Drawn in capitals on the shared picture, under the flag's name
share.headline: Text sent with a shared picture or link, before the link
share.headlineNoRank: Text sent with a shared picture or link, before the link
invite.playFor: Text sent with an invite link while the map is frozen
invite.playForNextSeason: Text sent with an invite link while the map is frozen between seasons
allegiance.playForUntil: {time} is a time of day or a date
video.progress: Accessible name of the progress bar while the video is made
video.headline.gain: Shown in capitals. {share} is a percentage, e.g. 45%
video.headline.loss: Shown in capitals. A call for help to the flag's players
video.headline.quiet: Shown in capitals. {share} is a percentage, e.g. 45%
news.fortified: {territory} is a country or an island
news.bomb.land: {land} is a country or an island
news.welcome: {player} is the player whose link brought the newcomer; {flag} is the flag the newcomer plays for
alerts.getPinged: Button: signs in with Discord to get a message when the flag is attacked
discord.failure.wait: On the Discord button after too many tries
discord.failure.notAvailable: On the Discord button when the Discord sign-in is off
feedback.kind: Label of the choice between 'An idea' and 'A bug'
report.details: Label of the text box of a report
report.optional: Placeholder of the text box: writing in it is optional
report.why: Label of the choice of the reason for a report
support.uploaded: Accessible name of the check mark of a file that was uploaded
support.failure.rejected: The server refused the message or report
